cbp_source.citation: CBP CSMS68855869, June5,2026, effective June8: original .82.06/.15 collection instructions; does not amend the proclamation.

method: Compare actual amounts under the proclamation, the native heading and CBP instruction. Price only when they agree; retain all different interpretations as unresolved. For partners, require that agreed US treatment also satisfies the source-defined lowest-rate rule.
limitation: The bulletin confirms the native additional-rate wording; it does not settle the inconsistent original combined-duty clause. No hierarchy or maximum/minimum is invented to decide differing source interpretations.
